checks.device_composition: remoteDeviceLabel() fills {device} with deviceName(owner_device_name, owner_device) - the wire name verbatim or the id's last 8 chars - else the nominative remote_another_device. The same label also feeds useRemoteSessionDevice -> remoteUnreachableText ('Устройство {device} не отвечает'), so the fallback must stay nominative.
checks.remote_on_device_judgement: 'место выполнения: {device}' is the right case-neutral form: the label-after-colon reads correctly for a Latin name ('место выполнения: cloud-node-1') AND the fallback ('место выполнения: другое устройство'). The catalogue's 'на {device}' pattern (ui.mesh.mesh_node.on_device, ui.chat.device.label.on) would yield ungrammatical 'на другое устройство' for the fallback; 'на устройстве «{device}»' yields 'на устройстве «другое устройство»'; 'устройство: {device}' doubles the noun. Slightly formal, but natural for a tooltip/screen-reader label line after a list comma; lowercase as the context requires.
checks.agreement: 'недоступно · не ответило' is neuter, agreeing with the implied 'устройство' and matching ui.chat.device_move.ineligible.no_answer ('не ответило на последнее чтение'). 'открыт' agrees with the existing opened_by_* values ('открыт агентом', 'открыт агентом {agent}'); {agent} sits in apposition after the instrumental 'агентом', so the verbatim name needs no case.
checks.placeholders: byte-identical sets vs English for all 7 keys ({device}; {device},{network}; {reason}; {agent},{label}; {label})
checks.punctuation: middle dot ( · ) preserved; Russian guillemets «» around {label} as the context asks and as the ru catalogue uses throughout; no full stops
checks.english_leakage: none; no Latin text outside placeholders
checks.width: 17-44 characters before substitution, comparable to English; one line in the ~256px tooltip except long labels/reasons, which wrap as in English
checks.bidi: not applicable (LTR); no hard-coded control characters
checks.tooling: generate.mjs --check, check-duplicates.mjs, check-strings.mjs, context-parity.mjs all exit 0; ledger-check reports ru/ui.chat.sidebar_notes stale source/target hashes as expected until the integrator updates i18n/ledger.json
